description: The Cuemon.Extensions.AspNetCore namespace contains both types and extension methods that complements the Cuemon.AspNetCore namespace while being an addition to the Microsoft.AspNetCore namespace. Provides an in-memory implementation of a throttling cache for ASP.NET Core.
